data.name: Yas Riva Reserve
overview: Yas Riva Reserve by Aldar Properties is a gated villa community located to the northeast of Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, offering **4, 5, and 6-bedroom villas.** Designed around modern family living, the community features contemporary architecture, generous layouts, private landscaped areas, and strong indoor-outdoor connections, with selected homes offering direct waterway access.

Yas Riva Reserve Yas Island combines privacy, waterfront surroundings, and family-focused amenities including a clubhouse, swimming pool, indoor and outdoor fitness spaces, children’s play areas, and sports and padel courts. Interconnected parks and landscaped open spaces further support an active, community-oriented lifestyle. The development also offers strong potential for high capital appreciation within one of Abu Dhabi’s most established destinations.

highlights.title: Prime Yas Island Location
highlights.text: Positioned northeast of Yas Island, with a new bridge connecting residents directly to the island’s attractions and amenities.

highlights.title: Exclusive Villa Collection
highlights.text: A gated collection of 292 four, five, and six-bedroom villas designed around privacy, space, and modern family living.

highlights.title: Waterway-Fronted Homes
highlights.text: Includes 45 waterway-fronted villas, with flexibility to add pontoons for boat mooring beside selected homes.

highlights.title: Extensive Community Amenities
highlights.text: Clubhouse, pool, fitness areas, play spaces, sports courts, retail, and a mosque support everyday community living.

highlights.title: Developed by Aldar Properties
highlights.text: Developed by Aldar Properties, extending the Yas Riva destination with a new villa-focused waterfront community.

highlights.title: Starting Price
highlights.text: Starting from AED 7.9M, the villas offer entry into a newly launched gated community on Yas Island.

highlights.title: Capital Appreciation Potential
highlights.text: Yas Island’s established attractions, connectivity, and evolving destination appeal support the project’s high capital appreciation potential.

highlights.title: Nature-Led Community
highlights.text: Interconnected linear parks, pocket gardens, and landscaped open spaces create a walkable, nature-led environment for residents.

data.amenitiesIntro: Yas Riva Reserve offers an exceptional array of world-class amenities designed to enhance every aspect of modern living.
data.paymentNote: Starting Price AED 7.9M. Handover 2030. Payment plans: 50/50.
locationText: Yas Riva Reserve Abu Dhabi is positioned northeast of Yas Island, directly opposite Yas Riva. A new bridge will connect the community to Yas Island, while convenient road connections provide access to Abu Dhabi city, Zayed International Airport, and Dubai.
data.investmentIntro: This off-plan project presents strong investment potential across the UAE, with projected rental yields of 6–8%, long-term capital appreciation, and growing demand from both residents and international investors.
marketContext: UAE off-plan properties continue to attract strong local and international investor demand.
Selected communities may offer rental yields of around 6–8%, depending on location and unit type.
Buyers may benefit from 10–15% potential price growth by handover in high-demand areas.
Properties from AED 2 million may qualify for UAE Golden Visa eligibility, subject to regulations.
data.developerText: Aldar Properties is a leading UAE real estate developer and manager, with a strong presence across Abu Dhabi and an expanding regional and international portfolio.
data.areaText: Yas Island is a purpose-built entertainment and residential destination spanning roughly 25 sq. km between mainland Abu Dhabi and Zayed International Airport. faqs.question: Where is Yas Riva Reserve located?

faqs.question: Who is the developer of Yas Riva Reserve?

faqs.question: What villa types are available at Yas Riva Reserve?
faqs.answer: Yas Riva Reserve by Aldar Properties comprises 4, 5, and 6-bedroom villas.

faqs.question: What amenities are available at Yas Riva Reserve?

faqs.question: How many villas are planned at Yas Riva Reserve?
